// One spatial particle. Velocity is in meters per second; Size is the world
// diameter in meters; Rotation is the billboard spin angle about the view
// axis and AngularVelocity its rate; a particle dies when Age reaches
// Lifetime.
type Particle3D
    implements IValue
{
    Position: Point3D;
    Velocity: Vector3D;
    Age: Duration;
    Lifetime: Duration;
    Size: Number;
    Color: Color;
    Rotation: Angle;
    AngularVelocity: AngularVelocity;
    Mass: Mass;
}
